# A template rendered only by a test is not rendered in production, so
# mutating it measures the tests against themselves. Those call sites are
# ignored by default, and a project whose only renders live in tests is
# told so rather than handed an empty report.
#
# --include-test-callers opts in, for a template set exercised only from
# tests.

! muxt test-template-mutations --dry-run --seed 1
stderr 'no templates.ExecuteTemplate calls found'
! stdout .

muxt test-template-mutations --dry-run --include-test-callers --seed 1
cmp stdout want.txt

-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- templates.gohtml --
{{define "greeting"}}Hello, {{.Name}}!{{end}}
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templateFiles embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templateFiles, "*.gohtml"))

type Greeting struct {
	Name string
}
-- render_test.go --
package server

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestGreeting(t *testing.T) {
	var buf strings.Builder
	if err := templates.ExecuteTemplate(&buf, "greeting", Greeting{Name: "World"}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if got, want := buf.String(), "Hello, World!"; got != want {
		t.Errorf("greeting = %q, want %q", got, want)
	}
}
-- want.txt --

  "greeting" templates.gohtml (complexity 1, dot: server.Greeting)
    PEND 1:29 action-zero
